3D & Eyes

3D strength (lower = less dizzy)
Eye gap

Head Camera

Head tracking camera
Camera off. Tape a webcam to the front of the headset, then press Start camera.
Turn amount
Camera direction
Turn your head right: the world should turn right. If it goes the wrong way, press Mount or Mirror until it's right. If it turns too much or too little, change Turn amount.

Hand Tracking

Hand tracking (on by default)
Walk in place (bob up and down to walk)
Pinch = press A · pinch and hold 1 second = home · swipe = turn or move in menus · make a fist on a hold to climb. On Meta Quest, the headset's own hand tracking is used instead.

Controls

Controller: right stick look · left stick move · A select / jump / throttle · B back · X friends · ☰ home · Y recenter · LB/RB 3D strength
Keyboard: arrows look · WASD move · Shift run · Space jump · Enter select · H home · Tab settings · G friends · V mute · Y recenter
